subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

“Where is my ______ ?” cried the boatman.
solution: The correct answer is **"oar."** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • **Homonyms** are words that have the same pronunciation but different meanings. • In this sentence, the boatman is asking about his oar. • **Oar** means a long pole that is flat and wide at one end and that you use for moving a small boat through water (rowing). (छोटी नाव चलाने में प्रयुक्त एक लंबा डंडा जिसका एक सिरा समतल और चौड़ा होता है; चप्पू) • **Example**: *She dipped her **oars**__ into the water and pulled.* • The correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct sentence**:* “Where is my __**oar**__ ?” cried the boatman. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Or: **a conjunction used to connect alternatives. (या अथवा (संभावनाओं या विकल्‍पों की सूची में प्रयुक्त)) • **O'er: **a poetic or archaic form of "over." ("ओवर" का एक काव्यात्मक या पुरातन रूप) • **Oat:** a type of cereal grain. (एक प्रकार का अनाज) 3c:Ta6a, The correct answer is **"Lousy."**
